Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

Jobomschrijving

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.
• Work closely with the investment team to gain a deep understanding of underlying funds, portfolio construction and investment strategies.
• Monitor fundraising activity, investor feedback and market developments to support future growth initiatives.
• Contribute to the firm's expansion by identifying new opportunities within the private wealth ecosystem.

The successful Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager has the following profile :

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Scrum Master
jobs.description:
What is cream all about?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects

Like Mael, a Scrum Master at Cream, embrace your role and be involved in a large-scale IT project. Your tasks will be:

• You guarantee a smooth use of the Scrum methodology

• You are responsible for delivering and achieving the goals of the project

• You organise and facilitate all the Scrum ceremonies: the daily Scrum, the sprint planning, the retrospective meetings

• You manage the different risks of the project and remove barriers (manage interdependencies & Impediments)

• You provide assistance or support to the Product Owner concerning the Product Backlog

• You can challenge yourself in contact with technical and business teams

What do we expect from our Consultant?

• You have between 1 to 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master

• You have a good knowledge of agile methodologies. A certification is an asset.

• You have strong communication, listening & relational skills

• You are fluent in French, Dutch and English

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

As a warehouse worker for Nike ELC, you are trained to execute several tasks, such as loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing Nike products, orderpicking, labelling and packaging orders.
 

We are looking for all-round employees, who are flexible to rotate over several area’s and tasks.
 

Nike has excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience; enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important!
 

 

 
• Your knowledge of English is very good (you can find vacancies for Dutch speaking candidates on www.startpeople.be/nike)
 
• You want a full-time job and are eager to outperform during peak periods (working extended during weekends)
 
• You want to work in an early and late shift pattern (06h00-14h00 Mon-Fri, 14h00-22h00 the week after)
 
• You have your own means of transportation (the Nike campus is not accessible by bus or train)
 
• You are looking forward to having a dynamic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy orders (+/- 20 kg on a regular basis)

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for orderpicker for the Bleckmann Ghent. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters

• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Are you a true foodie who has always dreamed of a job in the food industry?
 

Do you have experience in production and are you ready to turn your passion for snacks into a career? Then we are looking for you!
 

 
 

What will you be doing?
 

 
• Producing the tastiest snacks in a modern food environment.
 
• Mixing ingredients and monitoring the production process.
 
• Ensuring quality and efficiency at every step.
 

 

 
•  
Experience in food production is an advantage (school leavers welcome!).
 
 
•  
Problem-solving skills and an eye for quality.
 
 
•  
Passion for good food.
 
 
•  
Willingness to work nights (9 p.m. to 5 a.m.).
 
 
•  
Fluency in English.

Are you passionate about connecting top talent with exciting career opportunities? This role combines end-to-end recruitment with operational HR support, offering variety, ownership, and direct business impact.

Client Details

Our client is a growing international professional services organization with a strong focus on people, innovation, and business growth.

Description

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement recruitment strategies to attract high-quality talent
• Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and ideal candidate profiles
• Source and engage candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and professional networks
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from screening to offer stage
• Build and maintain talent pipelines for future hiring requirements
• Support employer branding initiatives, onboarding activities, and HR projects

A successful Talent Acquisition Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
• Initial experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Human Resources
• Fluent communication skills in English and French, good level of Dutch
• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities
• Proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented mindset

Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: IT Recruitment Consultant - Sales & Recruitment - Brussels
jobs.description:
Are you a proven Sales professional or an experienced Recruiter looking for your next challenge?

Or you have a strong sales mindset and looking for your first job?

At Oliver James, we're looking for ambitious 360° Recruitment Consultants to grow our Belgian IT market.

This is not a traditional HR role. You will build your own market, develop new business, headhunt top IT talent and manage the recruitment process from A to Z.

The Role

• Build and develop your own Belgian market
• Prospect and win new clients to build your portfolio
• Develop long-term relationships with decision-makers
• Head-hunt, interview and advise IT professionals
• Manage the recruitment process from A to Z
• Negotiate with clients and candidates
• Own your targets, pipeline and results
• Become an expert in your market

Who are we looking for?

Experienced Recruiters who want more commercial ownership, earning potential and career progression.

Sales Professionals with a strong background in B2B sales, business development or account management who want to build a career in recruitment.

In both cases, you are:
 

• Ambitious, competitive and commercially driven
• Comfortable with targets and prospecting
• A strong communicator and negotiator
• Fluent in French OR Dutch + English
• Holding a Bachelor's or Master's degree
We care more about your ability to build relationships, win business and deliver results than your job title.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

Looking for an international environment? Do you possess strong B2B communication skills? Then this technical support role within the medical device sector is looking for you! Here in Machelen, you will be handling incoming communication from internal and external stakeholders and be responsible for:

• Following strict internal guidelines to ensure a high level of reporting quality for medical matters.
• Processing and updating projects in SAP.
• Monitoring POs and shipments.
• Escalating more complex problems to the specific departments, which could be regarding accounting or more technical issues. It depends on the problem!
• Logging and archiving of reports and contracts.
• Backup for other administrative tasks.
 

• You communicate fluently in English AND Italian or Spanish.
• In possession of a university degree and a Belgian working permit
• Experience within larger company structures is a plus.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

Key Responsibilities

• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.

• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.

• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).
